notes: «وقال غير واحد عن ابن أبي مليكة عن المسور بن مخرمة» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
Ali is the subject of the story, not the speaker of the saying; the Prophet's words end the chain
Tirmidhi's own comments («قال أبو عيسى», «ويحتمل») are left out
